description: Let \(c,b\) be supplied compilers for \(\psi\), and let the finite standard-index list \(H\) be nonempty with \(\varphi_i\simeq\varphi_e\) for every \(i\) in \(H\). If \(b(n(e,H))\in B(H)\), then \(\varphi_e\) is nowhere defined, and \(\psi_j\) is nowhere defined for every \(j\) in the translated list \(B(H)\).
